title: Let’s not forget
intro: Qurbani, the takbirs, the Eid manners, the Hijrah and the Mawlid – let’s not forget!

learn.html: Let’s not forget! Say the missing words with your muallim:

items: After the Eid prayer, those who ______ offer a ______: a camel or ______ for up to ______ people, or a ______ for one person.
On the day before and all ______ days of Eid al-Adha we recite the ______: Allaahu akbar, ______, laa ilaaha illallaahu ______, Allaahu akbar, wa ______!
The good deeds for both Eids are ______. On Eid al-Fitr it is good to ______ something before going to the masjid; on Eid al-Adha it is good to ______ until the Eid prayer.
The Hijrah is the move of ______ (SAW) and the Muslims from ______ to ______ in ______.
The Hijri calendar has ______ months. Its week begins on ______, and a day begins at ______.
Muhammad (SAW) was born on ______ ______, ______, in ______. His father was ______ and his mother ______.
The Prophet (SAW) said: “The closest to me on the Day of Judgement will be those who send the most ______ on me.”

questions.q: How many people can share a cow for qurbani?
Which day does the Hijri week begin on?
When does a Hijri day begin?
What was the Prophet’s mother’s name?
